description: Uploads a media file in one request and returns its id. Send the file base64-encoded in media (raw bytes in multipart bodies). For a Post, set media_category to tweet_image (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB) or tweet_gif, then pass the returned id in media.media_ids on Create or Edit Post. DM media uses dm_image or dm_gif. Use the chunked upload endpoints for video.

additional_owners.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs who can use this media.

media.description: The media file to upload: base64-encoded in JSON bodies, raw bytes in multipart bodies.

media_category.description: The category of the media being uploaded.
